summary.en: Ion-mobility benchmarking clarifies what additional metabolomic peaks represent, while a normalization fix highlights the importance of validating drift correction.
summary.zh: 离子淌度评测厘清新增代谢组峰的来源，归一化软件修订则提醒关注漂移校正实现的正确性。

en: Ion mobility can improve mass-spectrometry selectivity, but additional peaks do not necessarily represent additional structural isomers. Today's selections examine that distinction and a software correction that can change previously processed profiling data.
The evidence spans a metabolomics preprint and a software release, rather than independent replication. Full-text evaluation and computational reproduction were not performed.
zh: 离子淌度能够改善质谱选择性，但新增峰并不必然代表新增结构异构体。今天的内容关注这一差别，以及一项可能改变既往分析结果的软件校正。
本篇证据来自代谢组学预印本和软件版本更新，并非独立复现；未开展全文评估或计算复现。

papers.title: Using XCiMS to Quantify the Benefits of Ion Mobility Spectrometry for Untargeted Metabolomics

read_scope.en: Author abstract indexed in PubMed and verified bioRxiv metadata; full text not read and results not reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 阅读PubMed收录的作者摘要，核验bioRxiv元数据；未读全文，未复现。

commentary.zh: XCiMS将LC–IMS–MS四维数据折叠为伪三维检峰，再沿感兴趣区域提取四维信号。人血浆高分辨淌度下最多约一半三维峰拆为多个四维峰，主要来自电荷异构体和离子簇，而非新分离出的结构异构体；16分钟色谱下嵌合MS/MS频率约减半。结论受样本与采集条件限制。
commentary.en: XCiMS detects peaks after collapsing LC–IMS–MS data into pseudo-3D space, then extracts 4D signals from 3D-guided regions of interest. In human plasma, up to half of 3D peaks yielded multiple 4D peaks with high-resolution IMS, largely charge isomers and ion clusters rather than newly resolved structural isomers; with a 16-minute separation, chimeric MS/MS frequency fell by about half. Findings depend on samples and acquisition settings.

papers.title: White Noise Normalization for Mass Spectrometry Profiling Data

read_scope.en: Official metadata, release notes and README; software not run and results not reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 阅读官方元数据、NEWS和README；未运行软件，未复现。

commentary.zh: winn 0.1.6修复漂移校正平滑项错误，旧版样条静默失败而回退替代模型；本次更新恢复预期校正并新增回归测试。官方称所有漂移校正特征的结果都会改变，旧分析值得复核；尚无独立量化准确率证据。
commentary.en: winn 0.1.6 fixes a formula error that silently prevented the intended spline-based drift correction, causing fallback models instead. The release restores documented smoothers and adds regression tests; authors say results change for every drift-corrected feature, making earlier analyses worth checking. This correctness update has no independent quantitative validation of downstream accuracy.
